name: The Council Assembled reduces Malediction's cooldown on Valanar's Vengeance (#1145)
contract: The Council Assembled 504103 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Council Assembled CD Reduc 505153 (a correctly-built SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN targeting Malediction 800776), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row restricted to Valanar's Vengeance/Keleseth's Calamity (SpellFamilyMask 393216), casting Valanar's Vengeance should cut Malediction's remaining cooldown by ~5 sec. Effect 1 (Atherann's Anguish -25 Rage) already works natively and is not exercised here. Casts Valanar's Vengeance rank 572795: the module progression chain upgrades rank 1 (560315, granted from level 13) through five further ranks up to 572795 (from level 56); a level-80 character owns only 572795, and every rank in this chain (verified directly against Spell.dbc) carries the same SpellFamilyFlags (262144, 0, 0) already covered by this row's mask.
